scripts.copy:screenshots: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const s=p.join('screenshots');const d=p.join('..','..','docs','screenshots');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)) if(f.endsWith('.png')) fs.copyFileSync(p.join(s,f),p.join(d,f));"
scripts.copy:petspot: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const s=p.join('screenshots','petspot_clinic');const d=p.join('..','..','docs','screenshots','petspot_clinic');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});if(fs.existsSync(s)) for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)) fs.copyFileSync(p.join(s,f),p.join(d,f));"
